Claim 1 (Currently amended): An ultrasonic surgical instrument assembly comprising: a handpiece; a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece; a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; and a light source attached to said handpiece so as to direct at least visible electromagnetic radiation along the probe towards a surgical site distal of the probe, __wherein said light source is removably attached to said handpiece via a fastener__.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1, further comprising a __battery__ mounted at least indirectly to said handpiece and operatively connected to said light source.

Claim 3 (Original): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2 wherein said power supply includes a coil disposed about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator.

Claim 4 (Original): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 3 wherein said power supply further includes a slow-drain capacitor for providing energy or power to said light source for a predetermined period of time after termination of power conduction through said cable.

Claim 5 (Original): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2, further comprising a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece.

Claim 6 (Original): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 5, further comprising at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece.

Claim 7 (Original): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 2 wherein said power supply is a battery.

Claim 8 (Original): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode.

Claim 9 (Original): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber extending from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The surgical instrument assembly defined in claim 1 wherein said light source is attached to a distal end of said handpiece and is oriented to provide illumination along said probe to the surgical site, __wherein said fastener comprises a clip__.

Claim 11 (Original): An accessory for a surgical instrument comprising a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece, and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said handpiece; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil __configured to be disposed__ about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil about the power cable.

Claim 13 (Original): The accessory defined in claim 12 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.

Claim 14 (Original): The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a battery.

Claim 15 (Original): The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said light source includes a light-emitting diode.

Claim 16 (Original): The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising an optical fiber and at least one additional fastener for removably attaching said optical fiber to said handpiece so that said optical fiber extends from said light source to a distal end portion of said handpiece.

Claim 17 (Original): The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is configured for attaching said light source to a distal end of said handpiece and for orienting said light source to provide illumination along said probe to a surgical site.

Claim 18 (Original): The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said fastener is taken from the group consisting of a clip, a clamp, and a band.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directable __substantially parallel__ to said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

Claim 20 (Original): The surgical method defined in claim 19 further comprising removably mounting said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece.

Claim 21 (Currently amended): The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including __configuring__ said coil __to be disposed__ about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator.

Claim 22 (Original): The surgical method defined in claim 21 wherein said power supply further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil, further comprising operating said capacitor to provide illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.

Claim 23 (Original): The surgical method defined in claim 19, further comprising removing said fastener and said light source from said handpiece after completion of an operation on said surgical site.

Claim 24 (Original): The surgical method defined in claim 19 wherein the applying of said fastener includes positioning said light source at a proximal or rear end of said handpiece, further comprising attaching an optical fiber to said handpiece so that said fiber extends from said light source at said proximal end of said handpiece to a distal end of said handpiece.

Claim 25 (Currently amended): An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil __configured to be disposed__ about a power cable extending to said handpiece, further comprising an additional fastener for removably attaching said coil about the power cable.

Claim 26 (Original): The accessory defined in claim 25 wherein said power supply component further includes a slow-drain capacitor operatively connected to said coil and connectable to said light source for providing illumination energy to said light source for a predetermined period of time after a termination of power conduction through said cable.
